activation_rules.meta_glasses_capture_enabled: Build includes real SDK AND platform/release-channel entitlement verified AND rollout eligible AND supported device/OS AND permission granted AND not killed
activation_rules.remote_glasses_capture_enabled: Glasses capture eligible AND active session explicitly armed locally AND same-account request AND fresh device state
activation_rules.meta_glasses_audio_enabled: Glasses capture eligible AND qualified audio capability AND explicit microphone permission and selected source
activation_rules.concentrate_analysis_enabled: Configured key AND qualified role profile AND verified privacy settings AND account/global budget AND provider readiness
activation_rules.onboarding_required: Amendment 2.2. Account session AND ONBOARDING_REQUIRED not false AND not killed. When on, a new account (or an existing account with fewer than 3 explicit saves, once) completes the taste questionnaire with at least 3 picks before its personal feed. When off, the questionnaire is offered but never blocks; anonymous visitors never see it either way
activation_rules.taste_seed_enabled: Amendment 2.2. TASTE_SEED_ENABLED not false AND not killed. Completing onboarding queues one taste_seed job (at most 6 Qloo requests, at most 3 concurrent). When off or when Qloo is unavailable, the feed shows labeled example cards; nothing is fabricated
activation_rules.fast_analysis_two_stage: Amendment 2.2. concentrate_analysis_enabled AND a qualified, ready vision_photo_enrich profile (Concentrate only, never Elorian) AND not killed. When off, photo analysis uses the single-call reading
activation_rules.while_we_look_enabled: Amendment 2.2. WHILE_WE_LOOK_ENABLED not false AND not killed. The strip only reads the existing FeedSnapshot and never starts generation

note: False activation defaults prevent unqualified rollout, not omission from implementation. CI experimental artifacts must contain and exercise the real feature. Server evaluation is authoritative. Disabling capture never deletes existing media. Amendment 2.2 flags (onboarding_*, taste_seed_enabled, fast_analysis_two_stage, while_we_look_enabled) follow specs/onboarding-and-fast-analysis.md.
